text:
incident-bot: Pager: P2 — elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate (region: eu-west-1). Pager fired 03:14 UTC. Incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/INC-4991

Alex: heads-up — I'm in transit and my primary slot tonight 00:00-08:00 UTC might be flaky. Flight delayed, sorry. Maria you mentioned you could shadow overnight earlier — are you still able to cover if pager fires? :wave:

Maria: i can take the first ~30m, i'm on a train with spotty wifi. flight boarding 03:40 local. i'll run initial checks and handoff by 03:45 if things keep paging. not comfortable being primary for >1h tonight.

Sam: I can pick up primary at 03:45 and sit the window until 08:00 UTC. can someone drop quick context/runbook pointers here so I can get up to speed fast? :+1:

Alex: quick runbook pointer — TL;DR checks and commands:
- check pod health: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-worker -o wide`
- tail logs: `stern model-worker -n inference --since 10m`
- check kv cache hit: metric `inference.kv_cache.hit_rate` (alert if <60%)
- incident doc: https://runbooks.redwood/latency-5xx

Alex: if it's model OOM fallback to smaller variant and/or reduce batch_size for the affected pool.

Jess: adding context — last week we saw the same spike when a broken prefix caused cache miss storm. If cache hit drops, try routing policy `fallback: small-variant` first. Also prefer canary config patch to avoid full redeploy.

ops-bot: Oncall assignment note: tentative primary swap queued — Sam -> primary at 03:45 UTC, Maria -> stepping down at 03:45 UTC. Please confirm with `ack` to finalize. :information_source:

Maria: ack, handing off at 03:45. left note in incident doc about worker-4 queue growth and some OOM traces. If OOM shows, escalate to eng-infra.

Sam: ack — taking. I'm starting the checks now. running `kubectl -n inference get hpa` and `kubectl -n inference top pods` then tailing logs.

Tariq: customer impact heads-up — support reported ~6 customers in eu-west-1 seeing 502/503s around 03:12-03:18 UTC. No data loss, just errors. We flagged internal status but not public page yet. Keep me posted if scope grows.

Sam: logs show repeated `CUDA out of memory` on model-worker-4: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.0 GiB` — looks like a worker-level OOM rather than network.

Sam: quick mitigation plan:
1) reduce batch_size on eu-gpu-2 pool from 8 -> 4
2) roll that change as 10% canary to confirm error reduction
3) if errors persist, scale pool or shift traffic to eu-gpu-1 fallback pool

Jess: i'll prepare the canary patch now. sample patch:
```yaml
- pool: eu-gpu-2
  config:
    batch_size: 4
    max_concurrency: 32
```
I'll roll to 10% canary and watch `inference.errors.5xx` and `inference.kv_cache.hit_rate`.

ops-bot: Deploy event: `rodeo deploy --canary 10% --manifest=patch-eu-gpu-2.yaml` started by Jess at 03:52 UTC. Link: https://deploys.redwood/roll/4991

Sam: observing canary now — 2 minutes in, 5xxs from the canary set dropped ~70%. kv_cache hit stable. Looks good.

Tariq: great — i'm updating support ticket and keeping customers in the loop. No broader region impact seen yet.

Alex: thanks everyone. Sam, you're primary 03:45-08:00 UTC. Please add a short blurb to the ops tracker when you take over, and ping if you need infra escalation. Maria, safe travels.

Sam: added to tracker and updated primary field. will watch for the next hour and then hand back to Alex if you're back online. :thumbsup:

Maria: thanks all, handing off now.

Jess: canary completed and promoted at 03:58 UTC — full rollout to pool eu-gpu-2. Monitoring.

ops-bot: Incident note appended: mitigation applied (batch_size reduction), errors reduced, customers seeing partial recovery. Closing temporary pager lock for this spike.

Sam: closing thread from my side — will reopen if we see regressions. :white_check_mark:

Alex: big thank you — excellent quick handoff. We'll do a short post-incident note tomorrow morning with root cause next steps.

Jess: noted for post-incident writeup.

incident-bot: Incident INC-4991 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

Sam: signing off as primary for this handover window. :wave:
